component.name: Ringmaster
component.summary: Sync and view your smart ring

description.p: Ringmaster talks to your smart ring directly over Bluetooth and keeps its history in a local database, with no cloud and no account.

ul.li: Heart rate, heart rate variability, blood oxygen, respiratory rate and skin temperature
Daily history with a calendar and charts over any range of dates
Nightly sleep against your goal, with trends over recent weeks
Quick readings on demand, background sync and notifications on your own thresholds
More than one ring, each with its own history
One-time import of the history kept by the official RingConn Android app

description.p: Tested on the RingConn Gen 2. Not affiliated with any ring maker. Not a medical device.

screenshot.caption: The ring, its last sync and the latest reading of each measurement
A month calendar and one day's averages
Time asleep each night against the goal, with averages
Steps each day against the goal, with averages

ul.li: The About dialog shows the same developer and links
Changes how releases are created and mirrored
Connects to a RingConn Gen 2, pairing it when needed, and syncs its full history
Latest, History, Sleep and Activity tabs
Background sync on a schedule, notifications and start at login
Several rings, one shown and synced at a time
Import from the official RingConn Android app
